obj.cause: In Python 3, `/=` is true (float) division, so `n` becomes a float (e.g. 12.3). The loop then uses float remainder/`while n` instead of integer digit stripping, so the sum is not 1+2+3=6.
obj.change: Replace `n /= 10` with integer division `n //= 10` so each step drops the last digit. Keep `s += n % 10` on integers.
